Mr. S. K. Mishra, Asc
 Coram: Justice Sibo Sankar Mishra
 Order

In this petition, the petitioner is seeking quashing of the entire criminal proceeding in connection with Dhusuri P.S. Case No.03 of 2018 corresponding to G.R. Case No.07 of 2018 for the offences under Sections 376/506/34 of I.P.C. pending in the Court of the learned J.M.F.C., Dhamnagar.
3.
Earlier the petitioner had filed a petition before this Court under Section 438 Cr.P.C. seeking anticipatory bail.

This Court vide order dated 30.07.2021 in ABLAPL No.8456 of 2019 passed the following order:-
<4.

Considering the submissions and viewing the materials on record including the statement of the victim recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C. as also other surrounding circumstances, while being not inclined to grant of anticipatory bail to the Petitioner,
this application is disposed of with the observation that in the event the Petitioner surrenders before the court in seisin of the aforesaid case and moves for his release on bail, the same shall be considered on its own merit and disposed of early in accordance with law so as to enable the Petitioner to approach the next higher forum early in case necessity so arises.=
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner at the outset submits that he is not pressing the present petition.
However, seeks indulgence of this Court for a direction to the Court below to dispose of his bail application on the same day, to be moved by him after surrendering before the Court.
5. This Court has already directed the petitioner to surrender and moved bail application in the proceeding initiated by the him under Section 438 Cr.P.C.
However, he has not surrendered as yet and seeks further time up till 31.08.2024.
